prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 公式文本 · 物理量 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "物理量" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 123px
  col 2: header "符号" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 3: header "公式" · longest unbreakable word 65px · one-line width 91px
  col 4: header "单位" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 5: header "说明" · longest unbreakable word 77px · one-line width 274px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"A compact physics formula reference: for each quantity it gives the symbol, defining formula, unit and a short explanatory note, for lookup and quick comparison rather than continuous reading.","reading":"Readers scan row by row: quantity name → symbol → formula → unit, then drop into the note. Columns 2–4 form a compact technical core, while 说明 is secondary but contains constants and caveats that must remain legible.","groups":["Columns 2 符号, 3 公式 and 4 单位 belong together: they are the technical identity of each quantity and should stay adjacent and compact.","Column 1 物理量 is the row entry point and label.","Column 5 说明 is explanatory annotation and can absorb wrapping."],"keep_intact":["symbols such as E_k, F, E","formula tokens and operators; ideally whole formulas, at minimum unbreakable terms such as ½mv² and G·m₁m₂/r²","units J and N","scientific notation such as 6.674×10⁻¹¹","short headers 符号, 公式, 单位"],"may_wrap":["物理量 names such as 理想气体状态方程","说明 prose and notes","formulas at = or spaces if necessary, but not inside tokens"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [69, 51, 90, 51, 98] · table 360×392px · row heights [60, 83, 83, 106, 60] · column headers wrapped 2/5 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [82, 51, 77, 51, 98] · table 360×392px · row heights [60, 83, 83, 106, 60] · column headers wrapped 2/5 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 1
Design r2C: widths [66, 51, 93, 51, 98] · table 360×392px · row heights [60, 83, 83, 106, 60] · column headers wrapped 3/5 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"The 公式 column at 90px is wide enough that every formula (E_k = ½mv², F = G·m₁m₂/r², pV = nRT, E = mc²) stays on one line with tokens intact — the core reference value of the table survives. 说明 at 98px is exactly the minimum for the 77px unbreakable strings (6.674×10⁻¹¹, J/(mol·K)), so nothing in the notes splits mid-token. 物理量 at 69px keeps its own header on one line and breaks names into tidy 3-character stacks.","problems":"The header band is ragged: 符号 and 单位 stack as 符/号 and 单/位 (2 lines) while 物理量, 公式 and 说明 sit on one line, so the header row is visually uneven and the top of every row looks misaligned. Col 1 also holds 2px more than it needs — its content wrapping is identical at 67px — while col 3 sits right at the fit threshold.","cause":"col2 and col4 were set to 51px, 1px short of the 31px header + 21px chrome (52px) needed for a two-character header; the 2px is wasted in col1 (69px vs the 67px that still fits 物理量 on one line)."},{"design":"r2B","good":"Giving 物理量 82px (61px of text) lets 理想气体状态方程 break into two lines instead of three, so the row-entry column reads as a phrase rather than a vertical stack.","problems":"This is the worst of the three: the 公式 column is shredded — formulas wrap to two lines and one token splits mid-word (G·m₁m₂/… /r²), so the defining formula, the very thing the table exists for, can no longer be read as a unit. The 说明 column is unchanged (still 4 lines, still the row-height driver), so nothing was actually gained for the space taken.","cause":"col3 was cut to 77px (56px of text) which is below the 86px needed to hold the longest unbreakable token (65px) — the 5px taken from the formula column were simply too few to help 物理量 and far too many for the formulas."},{"design":"r2C","good":"The most generous 公式 column (93px) — all four formulas sit comfortably on one line with clear breathing room, and 说明 keeps its 98px minimum.","problems":"Three of five headers now wrap (物理量, 符号, 单位), making the header band visibly ragged and taller; and 物理量 at 66px crushes 理想气体状态方程 into a three-line vertical stack while adding nothing to the formula column, which already fit at 90.","cause":"col1 at 66px leaves 45px of text, 1px below what 物理量 (3 characters) needs, so the header wraps; the 3px moved into col3 (90→93) buys no legibility that 90px did not already have."}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"hdr-fix","widths":[67,52,90,52,98],"change":"Take 2px from 物理量 (69→67, where wrapping is identical because 46px still fits the 物理量 header and 8-character names still break 3/3/2) and spend them on 符号 and 单位 (51→52 each), which is exactly 31px header + 21px chrome. Every header now sits on one line, the header band becomes even, formulas stay on one line at the proven 90px, and 说明 keeps its 98px minimum so 6.674×10⁻¹¹ and J/(mol·K) never split. Sum 359."},{"name":"hdr-fix-safe","widths":[66,52,91,52,98],"change":"Same header repair, but adds 1px of insurance to 公式 (90→91) in case the measured 91px one-line width is the true fit threshold; the cost is that 物理量 (45px of text) drops 1px below its 3-character header and wraps to 物理/量. Choose this only if formula one-line integrity is judged more important than a clean header band; otherwise hdr-fix dominates it."}]}
